propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state through show_state but omits the resolved alias from its return payload, causing agents to copy short collision-prone prefixes instead of durable aliases
the summary schema and library/MCP/CLI contracts institutionalize an alias-free shape, making four-character prefixes locally salient despite aliases being available elsewhere
agent guidance lacks an affirmative selection rule to prefer aliases for tracker commands and reserve canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts
pinned behavioral evaluation demonstrated that adding the resolved alias to local summaries independently produces alias-based commands in 25/25 samples, proving the fix sufficiency
the fix adds exact resolved alias as an additive field to summary results while preserving ticket_id echo semantics and fail-closed ambiguity handling
